EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
SPECIAL COMMODITY LEVY ACT, No. 48 OF 2007

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by the Section 5 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, I, MahindaRajapaksa, Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, dohereby make an order to waive off;

(i)the balance amount after collecting Rs. 25 per kg from the applied Special Commodity Levy of 10% or Rs. 100 per kgon the importation of fish, classifiable under the HS Heading of 03.02 and 03.03 (Other than the Mackerel fishcoming under HS Code 0303.54), listed out in the Schedule of the Order published in the Extraordinary GazetteNotification No. 2143/3 of 30th September, 2019.

(ii)Rs. 20 per kg from the applied Special Commodity Levey of Rs. 25per kg on the importation of Chillies (Dried, neithercrushed nor ground) classifiable under the HS Code of 0904.21.10 listed out in the Schedule of the Order publishedin the Extraordinary Gazette Notification No. 2132/13 of 18th July, 2019.

In terms of this Order, a Special Commodity Levey of Rs. 25 per kg on importation of fish (HS Heading of 03.02 and 03.03, otherthan the Mackerel fish coming under HS Code 0303.54) and Rs 5 per kg on importation of Chillies (Dried neither crushed norground/HS Code 0904.21.10) shall be collected for a period of two months commencing from November, 29th 2019.
MAHINDA RAJAPAKSA,Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development.
Ministry of Finance, Economy and Policy Development,Colombo 01,28th November, 2019.
